services.title: What I can do for your business
services.lead: Ten services across three areas. Not sure which one you need? We start with the assessment.

items.title: AI assessment and strategy
items.text: We look at how you work today and find where AI really saves time, without buying tools you won't use.

items.title: AI agents and integrations
items.text: We connect AI to the software you already use: AutoCAD, Excel, your CRM or your inbox. For example, drafting floor plans from a description or reading invoices and documents automatically.

items.title: AI marketing and content
items.text: Agents that research your niche, write copy, generate images and videos, improve your SEO and build your posting calendar. You review and approve.

items.title: AI workshops for teams
items.text: Hands-on sessions for any field: how to use ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools on your team's real tasks, with safe-use practices.

items.title: Websites, apps and chatbots
items.text: Fast websites, online stores, portals and custom apps, with an AI assistant that answers and books on WhatsApp or your site.

items.title: Process automation
items.text: Forms that land in your spreadsheet on their own, reminders, invoices and customer follow-up with n8n, Make or Zapier.

items.title: Data and reporting
items.text: We bring your sales, inventory and social data into clear dashboards so you decide with numbers, not hunches.

items.title: Cloud and DevOps
items.text: Cloud migration, hosting, automatic deployments and monitoring on AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, with costs under control.

items.title: Cybersecurity and backups
items.text: Security review, two-factor authentication, email protection and automatic backups that can actually be restored.

items.title: Support and maintenance
items.text: A monthly plan for your technology: Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, networks, updates and help when something breaks.

about.title: About us
about.lead: Buildream is a technology and AI consultancy from Costa Rica. We help businesses in any field work better with AI, software and cloud.
about.mission: AI moves faster than most businesses can follow. Our job is to translate it: understand how you work, pick what truly helps and leave it running, without jargon or hype.

principles.title: Results before tools
principles.text: We start from your business problem, not from the trendy technology.

principles.title: Clarity
principles.text: We explain every decision in plain words and document what we build for you.

principles.title: Security from day one
principles.text: Least-privilege access, backups and good practices in everything we touch.

principles.title: Continuous improvement
principles.text: We measure, adjust and grow with you, like a good pipeline.

about.experience: Buildream grows out of more than five years in tech: running enterprise-grade cloud platforms, backend development and networking. That same way of working, with clear processes, automation and monitoring, is what we bring to every project, whatever its size.

items.q: Do I need to know about technology?
items.a: No. We explain every step in plain words and leave you a short guide so you or your team can use it without depending on us.
Every project gets a tailored quote. We start with a free 30-minute call, then we send you a proposal with scope, timeline and price.

items.q: Do you work outside Costa Rica?
items.a: Yes. We work remotely with businesses across Latin America and beyond, in Spanish or English.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on scope. A website with a chatbot or a simple automation is usually ready in one to three weeks.
We stay with you for the first weeks to adjust what's needed. If you want, we can agree on a monthly support plan.
We use well-known tools, least-privilege access and explain where each piece of data lives. Nothing goes live without your approval.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: Buildream only collects the data you send through the contact form: name, email, company and message.
We use that data only to reply and prepare your proposal. We don't sell it or share it with third parties, except the provider that processes the form (Netlify).
You can ask us to delete your data at any time by writing to us from the contact page.
This site doesn't use tracking or advertising cookies.

terms.title: Terms of use
body: The content of this site is informational and is not a formal offer. Every service is agreed in writing in a proposal.
Third-party technology names and logos belong to their owners and are shown only to indicate the tools we work with.
Every project is defined and agreed in writing before work starts.
